purpose: Freeze the minimum pre-OOS cost-robustness node independently of MOMENTUM_V1 results.

minimum_required_node.interpretation: 2x adverse financing anchor plus 4 bps adverse slippage on every execution event

rationale.financing: Requires survival after doubling the already conservative direction-neutral adverse rollover anchor.
rationale.slippage: 4 bps = 0.04% of reference execution price per execution event; material but below the deliberately severe 8/16 bps diagnostic tail nodes.
rationale.selection_timing: Selected before OOS performance observation and without MOMENTUM_V1 results.

gate_semantics.cost_robustness_pass: F2_S4 must satisfy the future AO-E0 economic-support decision under the separately frozen B4 materiality rule and applicable statistical method.
gate_semantics.cost_robustness_fail: If F2_S4 is REFUTED/NOT_SUPPORTED, minimum cost robustness is not met even if lower-cost nodes pass.
gate_semantics.inconclusive: INCONCLUSIVE at F2_S4 remains INCONCLUSIVE; it is neither PASS nor REFUTED.
gate_semantics.above_threshold_nodes: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY; failure above F2_S4 does not by itself fail the minimum gate.
gate_semantics.monotonicity: Any lower-or-equal cost node inconsistent with a supported F2_S4 result triggers IMPLEMENTATION_OR_EVIDENCE_INVALIDATION, not selective node picking.
